what: Agents in flight, and why. A finished agent is REMOVED from this file, not marked done — the page shows what is happening now, and history lives in git.

agents.what: Five faults in what we tell the AI before it chooses
agents.why: The instructions contradict themselves: one part says the right fund is on the list 97% of the time, another says 75%, and both reach the model in the same breath. It is told it has six choices when it has seven. It is asked for seven picks from a list where, on average, two funds actually qualify — and it says so, in its own words. And the founder's company name was dropped from the brief by accident during a file move, in a system where one founder in three was already indistinguishable from another.

agents.what: One line of small print costing sixteen founders their fund
agents.why: A requirement to be based in southern Italy sits on a parent record covering all Italian research aid, and all sixty-seven funds beneath it inherit it — including Lombardy's own regional programme, whose published rules require being based in Lombardy. The obvious fix was tried and rolled back because it removed a safety check along with the bad rule. This does it narrowly.
